versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-video-wenzi-fetcher:

- Convert video (online link or local file) to clean text using a cloud-based large language model.
- Supports transcription, summary, copywriting extraction, and creative rewrites via custom prompts.
- Automatically removes filler words and redundant speech; outputs ready-to-use transcripts or custom content.
- Simple CLI with --file, --id, and --prompt options; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN setup.
- Designed for a variety of scenarios: meeting notes, social media scripts, video summaries, translation, interview processing, and more.
